meta.title: Low/high price periods
meta.description: Shows one tag in the composer's left control area (left of the model selector): low or high price, with the reason (weekend, holiday, or time) after a colon, without taking width from the model name. When holidays are not configured, the reason is replaced by 'holidays not configured'; the sidebar shows no notice. The tag matches 1017 in size and radius; low price is blue (the 1017 blue), high price is red.
